---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE]"
labels: '["enhancement"]'
---

## Feature Request
A one-sentence summary of the feature or improvement.

## Detailed Description
If applicable, explain the feature in detail. Include goals, scope, and how it should work.

### What the issue is about
What problem does this solve or what capability does it add?

### Why it matters
What is the impact, business value, or user benefit?

### Context and background information
If applicable, what background, links, prior work, related tickets, or assumptions are relevant here?

### Stakeholders
Who are the stakeholder(s) - points of contact for questions and approvals?

## Acceptance Criteria
What are the conditions that must be met for this issue to be marked `Done`? If there are multiple items, list them as a checklist.

## Additional Context
Anything else we should know (dependencies, risks, assumptions, etc)?
